rationales.inherited_formation: The accepted frozen V2.3.2 candidate family supplies normalized evidence without relabeling either sealed formation FAIL.
rationales.numerical_tolerance: The suite-wide exact-enumeration tolerance is retained for identities, clones, and yoked trajectories.
rationales.bank_seed_block: A fixed 1,800-seed development block permits honest intention-to-simulate qualification across three nonsaturated strength strata without regeneration.
rationales.history_lengths: A preregistered range of short-to-full frozen developmental histories varies evidence amount without reading maintenance outcomes or assigning posterior strength.
rationales.history_profile_cycle: The cycle uses only frozen public V2.3.2 theory configurations and varies precision, controllability, and localization before any bank result is viewed.
rationales.strata: The adopted 0.60-0.75, 0.75-0.90, and 0.90-0.98 ranges cover moderate through very strong formed states while excluding numerical saturation.
rationales.minimum_worlds: Forty worlds per stratum yields the adopted minimum 120 paired worlds with equal stratum weight.
rationales.serialization: Canonical JSON bytes and SHA-256 make provenance and bitwise clone custody independently checkable.
rationales.maintenance_seed_blocks: Fresh disjoint development and robustness blocks are below 800000 and are reserved before implementation.
rationales.duration: Thirty-two slices permit partial delivery and censoring-dose contrasts without relying on a single acute event.
rationales.censoring_doses: The adopted five doses identify a graded availability curve including full observation and complete censoring anchors.
rationales.closed_loop_censoring: A 0.75 avoidance-contingent censoring probability is strong enough to alter delivered counts while retaining observed evidence in the open arm.
rationales.outcome_reliabilities: Reliability 0.85 makes corrective and danger streams informative but not deterministic, preserving finite likelihood ratios.
rationales.adverse_outcome_proportion: A 0.15 adverse minority prevents the safe-world assay from becoming a deterministic all-safe script.
rationales.corrective_configuration: High control, integrated broadcast, ordinary precision, and no real danger define corrective observations in the frozen public formation vocabulary; the two self-absent safe-support cells have negative frozen P/T and P/D log BFs and are sampled from the renormalized T row.
rationales.policy: A centered finite-temperature logistic rule keeps avoidance stochastic across the allowed initial-strength range; the conjugate availability prior learns observation access, not efficacy or attribution.
rationales.sham_feedback: Candidate-common feedback exercises the sham channel while guaranteeing zero pairwise BF.
rationales.bootstrap: Ten thousand whole-world paired resamples resolve stratum-balanced 95% intervals without treating slices as independent worlds.
rationales.robustness: Symmetric local multipliers cover every adopted sweep dimension without changing the frozen primary analysis.
